Core_SK_Patch.PsychicRitualRoleDef_Minim.label: invoker
Core_SK_Patch.PsychicRitualRoleDef_Minim.description: The invoker must have at least 200% psychic sensitivity.

Core_SK_Patch.PsychicRitualDef_Eradicate.label: sever the cult
Core_SK_Patch.PsychicRitualDef_Eradicate.description: Project a violent counter-resonance through the void. Every cultist who is currently invoking or chanting in a psychic ritual or hate chant will die immediately, and any death refusal they possess will be stripped away before death. Other cultists are unaffected.
Core_SK_Patch.PsychicRitualDef_Eradicate.outcomeDescription: All cultists currently invoking or chanting in a psychic ritual or hate chant will immediately die. Their death refusal will be removed first. Other cultists are unaffected.
